email.body1:
Heather, saw HSI launched Sky, your AI assistant, and expanded through the Enhesa partnership and recent acquisitions.

New capabilities and a wider portfolio usually mean more in-market accounts than the team can touch before everyone ramps on the message, and that is where pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for HSI off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Heather, quick follow-up for HSI.

With a broader product story to sell, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Heather, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to peer training and compliance teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
